en: Proverbs 25

p.src: 1  These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

en: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
u.src: 1  These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

p.src: 2  It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
u.src: 2  It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

p.src: 3  As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

en: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
u.src: 3  As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

p.src: 4  Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

ja: け。 そうすれば、精錬する者が用いる
en: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
u.src: 4  Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

p.src: 5  Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

ja: け。 そうすれば、その
en: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
u.src: 5  Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

p.src: 6  Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

ja: くしてはならない。 身分の高い者たちの間に自分の
en: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
u.src: 6  Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

p.src: 7  for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

ja: われるほうが、 あなたがその目で見た君主の前で 低い場所に下げられるより良い。
en: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
u.src: 7  for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

p.src: 8  Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

ja: いで訴えを法廷に持ち込んではならない。
en: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
u.src: 8  Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

p.src: 9  Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

en: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
u.src: 9  Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

p.src: 10  lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

en: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
u.src: 10  lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

p.src: 11  A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

ja: のりんごのようである。
en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
u.src: 11  A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

p.src: 12  As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

ja: に対する知恵ある者の叱責は、
en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
u.src: 12  As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

p.src: 13  As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

ja: にとって、 刈り入れの
たさのよう。 主人の心を生き返らせる。
en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
u.src: 13  As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

p.src: 14  As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

en: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
u.src: 14  As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

p.src: 15  By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

ja: 強く説けば支配者も納得し、
en: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
u.src: 15  By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

p.src: 16  Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

ja: つけたか。 必要なだけ
en: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
u.src: 16  Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

p.src: 17  Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

ja: には、めったに足を運ぶな。
en: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
u.src: 17  Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

p.src: 18  A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

ja: りのあかしをする人は、 こん棒、
en: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
u.src: 18  A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

p.src: 19  Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

ja: することは、 傷んだ
en: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
u.src: 19  Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

p.src: 20  As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

ja: 寒い日に衣服を脱がせる者や、 重曹に酢を注ぐ者のように、
うのも、そのようなものだ。
en: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
u.src: 20  As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

p.src: 21  If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

en: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
u.src: 21  If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

p.src: 22  for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

en: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
u.src: 22  for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

p.src: 23  The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

en: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
u.src: 23  The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

p.src: 24  It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
u.src: 24  It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

p.src: 25  Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

en: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
u.src: 25  Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

p.src: 26  Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

en: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
u.src: 26  Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

p.src: 27  It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

en: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
u.src: 27  It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

p.src: 28  Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

en: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
u.src: 28  Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
